description: This Java class enforces size restrictions on JSON-based index entries related to 'things' in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It provides methods for creating instances tied to a specific 'thing' ID and for checking and adjusting JSON values to conform to maximum length constraints, primarily focusing on string values and handling composite structures.

classes.name: IndexLengthRestrictionEnforcer
classes.description: A utility class for enforcing size restrictions on index entries associated with a specific 'thing' based on its ID. It manages constraints on the length of index keys and values and provides mechanisms for truncating or rejecting oversized entries.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of IndexLengthRestrictionEnforcer for a given 'thingId', after verifying that the ID is valid and non-empty.

methods.name: enforce
methods.description: Checks a JsonValue against size constraints, adjusting string values if necessary or rejecting entries that are too large to index.

methods.name: calculateThingIdNamespaceAuthSubjectOverhead
methods.description: Calculates the overhead size based on the 'thingId' for size enforcement, including namespace and authentication subject length.
